Part one.
Create your JetUP account.
Open the Partner link from your sponsor.

Type your first name, last name,
email and a password, using English letters only.
Choose your country,

Your password needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter,
a number and a special character, with no spaces.
Now read the two boxes before you tick them.

Part four.

Log in at portal.tagmarkets.com,

Tap Next, choose Crypto, and tap Submit.
Pick the coin and network you're sending from.

Copy the deposit address and the exact amount.

Now open your exchange.

The wrong network means lost funds, so check twice.

Check that the address matches TAG Markets exactly.
Tap Confirm Withdrawal,

Back in TAG Markets, wait for Payment found,
